feature: Endpoint create-notice dari EHT lewat SFTP (/v1/ehtsftp-create-notice) dan path SFTP ura.sftp.ehtnopo.path
note: Endpoint menerima array notice dan memakai alur create notice yang sama, dan BatchErrorCollector punya filter duplicate khusus subsystem EHTSFTP. Path SFTP /neht/eht/ ada di properties tetapi tidak ada kode Java yang membacanya, dan pemanggil endpoint tidak ada di enam repo. Tidak masuk OCMS3.1-3.3 yang menyebut real-time webhook.
note_en: The endpoint accepts a notice array and uses the same create-notice flow, and BatchErrorCollector has a duplicate filter specific to the EHTSFTP subsystem. The SFTP path /neht/eht/ is in the properties but no Java code reads it, and no caller of the endpoint exists in the six repos. It is not covered by OCMS3.1-3.3, which describe a real-time webhook.

feature: Salinan lama webhook REPCCS di ocmsadminapi (/v1/repccsWebhook-create-notice) tanpa JWT dan tanpa cek subscription key
note: Jalur REPCCS yang dipakai OCMS3.1 sekarang ada di ocmsadminprivateapi (/v1/repccsWebhook). Salinan lama di ocmsadminapi masih aktif dan dilewatkan filter JWT dan interceptor otorisasi, tanpa cek key. Apakah masih dipanggil REPCCS: cannot verify from repo.
note_en: The REPCCS path used by OCMS3.1 now lives in ocmsadminprivateapi (/v1/repccsWebhook). The older copy in ocmsadminapi is still active and bypasses the JWT filter and the authorization interceptor, with no key check. Whether REPCCS still calls it: cannot verify from repo.

feature: Report Notices Created in Backend (PLUS / OCMS): export Excel per offence type untuk notice yang dibuat di backend (subsystem 004/005)
note: Report saudara dari report enforcement system di OCMS3.3, tetapi untuk notice yang dibuat PLUS atau staff OCMS, bukan frontend enforcement system. Tidak ada story epic 3 yang menyebutnya; mungkin masuk story epic lain.
note_en: A sibling of the enforcement-system report in OCMS3.3, but for notices created by PLUS or OCMS staff rather than frontend enforcement systems. No epic 3 story names it; it may belong to a story in another epic.
